subject: Laptop will not power on after update
body: It was fine yesterday. This morning it powers on for a second, fans spin, then nothing. Tried a different charger and a different socket.

subject: Cannot access shared finance folder
body: I can get to the Sales folder but the Finance one gives 'access denied'. I need the month-end pack by Thursday.

subject: Request new starter account - Warehouse
body: New warehouse operative starting Monday. Needs the same access as the existing pickers plus a scanner.

subject: Outlook repeatedly asking for password
body: Every hour or so Outlook pops up asking for my password. I type it, it goes away, then it comes back.

subject: Depot WAN link dropping every few minutes
body: The Leeds depot link keeps dropping. Teams calls fail and the WMS scanners lose their session. It has been happening since about 08:30.

subject: Please install Sage 200 client
body: Please install the Sage 200 client on my laptop - I have just moved to the finance team.

subject: Printer on floor 2 jamming constantly
body: The printer on floor 2 jams on nearly every job. There is no paper stuck that I can see.

subject: MFA reset - lost phone
body: I have lost my phone so I cannot approve the sign-in prompt. I am locked out of everything.

subject: New starter kit for 3 site engineers
body: Three site engineers start next week. Each needs a laptop, a phone and access to the site drive.

subject: EPOS till 4 offline at Brightling Leeds
body: Till 4 at the Leeds store is offline - it will not connect to EPOS Central. The other three tills are fine.

subject: Mailbox full, cannot send
body: My mailbox is full and I cannot send anything. I have deleted what I can.

subject: How do I share a Teams recording?
body: How do I share a Teams recording with someone outside the company?

subject: VPN disconnects when on site cabin 4G
body: The VPN drops every few minutes when I am working from the site cabin on 4G. It is fine on wifi at the office.

subject: Request additional monitor
body: Could I have a second monitor please? I am working across two spreadsheets most of the day.

subject: Backup job failed overnight - SQLDB-Finance
body: The overnight backup for SQLDB-Finance failed again. This is the third time this month.

subject: Suspicious phishing email reported
body: I have had an email claiming to be from the bank asking me to confirm my details. I have not clicked anything.

subject: Access to Payroll Portal for new HR advisor
body: Our new HR advisor needs access to the Payroll Portal - same level as the existing advisors.

subject: Warehouse scanners not connecting to WMS
body: The scanners in aisle 7 keep losing their WMS session when the pickers move between racks.

subject: Password expired while working away
body: My password expired while I am away from the office and I cannot change it over VPN.

subject: Order replacement docking station
body: My docking station has stopped charging the laptop. The lights come on but nothing else happens.

subject: Site Access Control card reader unresponsive
body: The card reader on the side entrance is unresponsive. Staff are having to come round to reception.

subject: Request shared mailbox for tenders inbox
body: Please set up a shared mailbox for tenders so the whole bid team can see incoming enquiries.

subject: Sage 200 reports running very slowly
body: The Sage reports that used to take a minute are taking ten. It started around the 28th.

subject: Guest wifi not issuing addresses
body: Guests cannot get onto the wifi - it connects but never gets an address. We have visitors in all week.

subject: Decommission leaver account - Legal
body: Please disable the account for the legal assistant who left on Friday and forward her mail to her manager.

subject: Teams call quality poor from Bristol depot
body: Teams calls from the Bristol depot are breaking up badly. Video is worse than audio.

subject: Two-factor prompt loop on new phone
body: I set up my new phone and now the two-factor prompt just loops - approve, then it asks again.

subject: Request Adobe Acrobat licence
body: I need Adobe Acrobat to edit the tender PDFs. Reader will not let me combine documents.

subject: File server disk nearly full
body: SRV-FILE01 is at 92% again. We had to clear space last month too.

subject: Cannot print to MFD after firmware update
body: Since the printer firmware update I cannot print at all - error 0x0000011b.

subject: New depot switch install - Leeds
body: The Leeds mezzanine extension needs a switch installing before the new scanner docks arrive.

subject: Recover deleted contract folder
body: I have deleted the contracts folder by mistake. I need it back if possible - there is work in there from this week.

subject: Set up meeting room display
body: The meeting room display will not pick up my laptop over HDMI or wirelessly.

subject: Antivirus flagged file on SRV-APP02
body: Antivirus has quarantined a file on SRV-APP02 and the application will not start.

subject: Request bulk export of ITSM tickets
body: Can I get an export of all our tickets for the last quarter for the board pack?

subject: Onboard 12 seasonal warehouse staff
body: Twelve seasonal staff start in the warehouse on the 1st. They all need accounts and scanner logins.

subject: Air-con alarm in HQ comms room
body: The comms room is alarming on temperature again. It is noticeably warm in there.

subject: Mobile handset replacement - damaged screen
body: I dropped my work phone and the screen is cracked - it still works but it is hard to read.

subject: SharePoint sync errors on 4 laptops
body: Four of us are getting SharePoint sync errors on the tender library. The files look out of date.

subject: Quarterly access review evidence needed
body: I need the evidence pack for the quarterly access review - who has access to what.
